sections.Profile:
The "Cover Girl" pinball machine, produced by J.H. Keeney & Co. in December 1947, is a single-player electro-mechanical game notable for being the company's first flipper game. The playfield features seven flippers, ten passive bumpers, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Keeney and Sons
- Years made: 1947
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Wood Rail
